title: Appointment Series Late-Cancellation Notice Bands
content:
Rate card — notice bands applied to the late-cancellation fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The late-cancellation notice share is 50 percent where the cancellation gave at least 18 hours of notice, 75 percent where it gave at least 12 hours but fewer than 18 hours, and 100 percent where it gave fewer than 12 hours. The share is read as a percentage of the late-cancellation basis and multiplies it.

**Which cancellation.** The notice is the whole hours of notice recorded on the most recent cancellation on the series that carries no minutes late, the one with the latest appointment date.

| Whole hours of notice recorded | Notice share |
|---|---|
| 18 or more | 50 percent |
| 12 to 17 | 75 percent |
| 0 to 11 | 100 percent |

**Edges of the bands.** 18 hours falls in the 50 percent band and 17 hours in the 75 percent band; 12 hours falls in the 75 percent band and 11 hours in the 100 percent band.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** On a late-cancellation basis of USD 40.00, a cancellation with 15 hours of notice carries a 75 percent notice share: 75 percent of USD 40.00 is USD 30.00.
